stem: 以下哪些被认为是有效的反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义培训项目的最佳实践？(选择三项.)

options.A: 培训应涵盖实际案例，运用案例研究，并提供有关如何遵守政策的信息。
options.B: 应当保存最新的记录，包括培训日志和完成日期。
options.C: 培训应当广泛、高水平且不针对特定角色，以便覆盖最广泛的受众。
options.D: 培训应涵盖不遵守政策和程序所带来的后果。
options.E: 培训应始终由独立的第三方提供。

stem_en: Which of the following are considered best practices for effective AML/CFT training programs? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: Training should cover practical examples, use case studies, and provide information on how to comply with policies.
options_en.B: Up-to-date records, including training logs and completion dates, should be maintained.
options_en.C: Training should be broad, high-level, and not role-specific in order to reach the largest audience.
options_en.D: Training should cover the consequences of not complying with policies and procedures.
options_en.E: Training should always be provided by an independent third party.
